text: Appeal of Order to Comply (September 27, 2018) for 48 Willamere Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply (September 27, 2018) for 48 Willamere Drive, Folder No. 18 232580 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to February 28, 2019, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
